diagnosis: The prior replacement affected the similarly named primed theorem, whose hypothesis `hf` is only `Continuous f`. In the designated unprimed theorem, `hf : IsTestFunction f`, so `f` itself is a valid test function; its self-inner-product is nonnegative, continuous, and integrable.
proof_body:
by
  have hf' := hg f hf
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg] at hf'
  · rw [Continuous.ae_eq_iff_eq] at hf'
    · funext x
      have hf'' := congrFun hf' x
      simpa using hf''
    · have hfcont : Continuous f := hf.smooth.continuous
      fun_prop
    · fun_prop
  · intro x
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply]
    apply real_inner_self_nonneg'
  · apply IsTestFunction.integrable
    exact IsTestFunction.inner hf hf
